title: Umehluko Wekhwalithi Yevidiyo 360p, 720p ne-1080p: Khetha Kahle
description: Umehluko wekhwalithi yevidiyo engu-360p, 720p ne-1080p: ukuthi i-resolution isho ukuthini, ithinta kanjani ubukhulu befayela, nokuthi ukhetha kanjani.
body:
Uma ulanda ividiyo, ngokuvamile unikezwa izinketho ezimbalwa ezifana no-360p, 720p, ne-1080p. Pho, yikuphi okufanele ukukhethe? Le ndatshana ichaza umehluko wekhwalithi yevidiyo engu-360p, 720p, ne-1080p ngolimi olulula, ukuze ukhethe i-resolution efanele izidingo zakho, idatha yakho, nendawo yokugcina yefoni yakho.

Zisho ukuthini izinombolo 360p, 720p, ne-1080p?

Lezi zinombolo zibonisa i-resolution, okungukuthi inani lemigqa yama-pixel ohlangothini olufushane lwevidiyo. Lapho inombolo inkulu khona, kuba yimininingwane eminingi engaboniswa. Uhlamvu “p” luvela ku-progressive scan, indlela yokubonisa isithombe evame ukusetshenziswa kuvidiyo yedijithali.

  • 360p: cishe ama-pixel angu-640 × 360 kuvidiyo evundlile. Iyikhwalithi ejwayelekile ephansi.
  • 720p: cishe ama-pixel angu-1280 × 720, evame ukubizwa ngokuthi i-HD.
  • 1080p: cishe ama-pixel angu-1920 × 1080, eyaziwa ngokuthi i-Full HD.

Kumavidiyo ame mpo afana nalawo asakazeka kakhulu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, izilinganiso ziyaguqulwa. Isibonelo, ividiyo emi mpo engu-1080p icishe ibe ngama-pixel angu-1080 × 1920.

Umehluko wekhwalithi yevidiyo engu-360p, 720p, ne-1080p empilweni yangempela

360p: yonga idatha nendawo yokugcina

Le resolution ikhiqiza ifayela elincane kakhulu. Isithombe sisacacile ngokwanele esikrinini esincane sefoni, kodwa umbhalo omncane nemininingwane yobuso kungabonakala kufiphele kancane. Ifanelekile uma ufuna nje ukulondoloza ividiyo ehlekisayo ukuze uyibuke kafushane, noma lapho idatha ye-inthanethi isiphela.

720p: inketho elinganiselayo

Kubantu abaningi, i-720p iyindawo emaphakathi efanele. Isithombe sesicacile esikrinini sefoni, kanti ifayela lisalula kune-1080p. Le nketho ifanele izifundo, amaresiphi, noma amavidiyo ofuna ukuwabuka kaningana.

1080p: icace kakhulu

Uma imininingwane ibalulekile, isibonelo amavidiyo endawo enhle, izifundo ezibonisa umbhalo omncane, noma amavidiyo ofuna ukuwabuka ku-tablet, ku-laptop, noma ku-TV, khetha i-1080p. Umphumela walokho wukuthi ifayela likhulu futhi ukulanda kuthatha isikhathi eside.

Ubukhulu befayela nedatha

Ngokuvamile, lapho i-resolution iphakeme, ifayela liba likhulu. Kodwa ubukhulu obuqondile buthintwa nangobude bevidiyo, ukunyakaza okukuyo, nendlela ecindezelwe ngayo (compression). Amavidiyo amabili anobude obufanayo angaba nobukhulu obuhlukile. Ngakho, esikhundleni sokuqagela izinombolo, bambelela kulo mthetho olula: uma indawo yokugcina noma idatha incane, yehlisa i-resolution.

Indlela yokukhetha ikhwalithi lapho ulanda

Ku-I Need Save, ukukhetha ikhwalithi kulula kakhulu:

  1. Ku-app yezokuxhumana, thepha okuthi Yabelana (Share) bese uthi Kopisha ilinki (Copy link).
  2. Vula i-ineedsave.com bese unamathisela ilinki ebhokisini elikhona, noma uthephe okuthi Namathisela.
  3. Cindezela okuthi Landa.
  4. Bheka uhlu lwezinketho zevidiyo ezivelayo, bese ukhetha i-resolution oyifunayo.

Izinketho ezikhona zincike kokuthunyelwe kwangempela. Amanye amavidiyo anezinketho kusukela ku-360p kuya ku-1080p, amanye anikeza ikhwalithi eyodwa noma ezimbili kuphela. Uma inkinobho ibonisa okuthi Iyalungisa…, linda kancane; ividiyo iyacutshungulwa futhi ukulanda kuzoqala ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Ukukhetha i-1080p ngeke kwenze ividiyo ebifiphele ekuqaleni icace. Ikhwalithi yokulandiwe ngeke idlule eyevidiyo eyalayishwa ngumdali.

Kuthiwani ngama-codec e-HEVC ne-H.264?

Ngaphandle kwe-resolution, kukhona enye into ethinta ukuthi ividiyo izodlala kahle yini, okuyi-codec. Amanye amavidiyo e-TikTok asebenzisa i-codec ye-HEVC (H.265). Le fomethi isebenza kahle, kodwa amafoni amadala kakhulu angase angakwazi ukuyidlala kahle. Inketho ye-H.264 idlala cishe kuwo wonke amadivayisi. Ngakho, uma ividiyo ima-ima efonini endala, zama ukuyilanda futhi ngenye inketho ekhona. Umhlahlandlela ophelele usendatshaneni ethi ividiyo elandiwe ayidlali.

Udinga umsindo kuphela?

Uma okudingayo kungumculo noma izwi elisevidiyweni kuphela, akudingeki ulande ividiyo engu-1080p. Khetha inketho ethi Umsindo, kungaba ngekhwalithi yangempela noma i-MP3 ye-192 kbps eguqulwe evidiyweni. Ubukhulu bayo buvamise ukuba buncane kakhulu futhi ingadlalwa ngqo ku-app yomculo. Kuchazwe kumhlahlandlela othi indlela yokuguqula amavidiyo ezinkundla zokuxhumana abe yi-MP3.

Noma ngabe ukhetha iyiphi ikhwalithi, sebenzisa amavidiyo alandiwe ukuze kube ngokwakho kuphela futhi uhloniphe amalungelo obunikazi abadali. Cela imvume ngaphambi kokuphinda uthumele futhi ubalule igama lomdali.

Imibuzo evame ukubuzwa

Iyiphi ikhwalithi enconywa kakhulu?

Ukuze ubuke efonini, i-720p ivamise ukwanela. Khetha i-1080p uma ufuna ukubuka esikrinini esikhulu, ne-360p uma ufuna ukonga indawo yokugcina.

Kungani ingekho inketho ye-1080p?

Izinketho zekhwalithi zilandela ividiyo yangempela. Uma umdali alayishe nge-resolution ephansi, noma inkundla inikeza amakhwalithi athile kuphela, inketho ye-1080p ngeke ivele.

Ingabe amavidiyo angu-1080p athatha isikhathi eside ukulanda?

Ngokuvamile yebo, ngoba ifayela likhulu. Ijubane libuye lincike oxhumanweni lwakho lwe-inthanethi.
